method: 사용자가 리듬게임 버튼으로 읽히지 않는다고 평가하고 에이전트의 구체적인 프롬프트 작성을 요청함. 큰 사각 키캡과 작은 정면 분출구를 명확히 분리하도록 지시함.

variants.label: A
variants.prompt:
Edit the attached full-frame rhythm-game concept. Keep the outer frame, side armor, tall unmarked cyan gauges, central four lanes, palette, illustration style and camera unchanged. Redesign ONLY the four lower input modules so they unmistakably read as a four-key arcade rhythm-game controller.

Replace every large circular glowing disc with a LARGE RECTANGULAR PHYSICAL KEYCAP. Four equally sized broad keys in one straight row, one directly beneath each lane. Each key has a broad FLAT opaque charcoal pressing surface, straight sides, softly bevelled small corners, shallow visible front/side walls, and a narrow dark travel gap beneath it. The keys should look comfortable for rapid repeated finger taps. The pressing face occupies most of its module, with very little casing around it. Keep all four key faces the same neutral dark material; use a fine silver edge to separate them from the housing.

Below each key, in the fixed front wall of its base, place ONE SMALL FORWARD-FACING EXHAUST APERTURE, clearly separate from the movable keycap. Its diameter is about one quarter of the key width, with a simple dark inset rim. First and fourth off/dark, second pale cyan, third gold. The two lit apertures have identical construction and emission shape, only the effect color differs. They face the viewer.

The visual hierarchy must be LARGE TAP TARGET above SMALL OUTPUT below. Remove the old giant concentric rings and circular luminous faces completely. No circular buttons, domed lenses, speakers, dials, turbines, reactor orbs, circular ornaments or bright cores inside the pressing surfaces. Keep the big keys visibly opaque and pressable; concentrate colored light in the tiny outlets beneath. No extra keys, no text, no gauge ticks. Show one complete frame.
